gaps.sentence: ___ of the workforce is part-time now.
gaps.hint: pattern: ___ of + specific group; singular verb
gaps.explanation: 'Half of the workforce is ...' is the correct pattern; 'the half of' is not used in this position.

gaps.sentence: There is ___ use asking him — he never checks his messages.
gaps.explanation: 'There is no use doing something' = it is pointless.
'Cut something in half' is the fixed expression; 'in middle' would need 'the middle'.

gaps.sentence: One of my shoes is tighter than ___.
gaps.hint: shoes come in pairs of two
gaps.explanation: 'One ... than the other' is the pattern for two items; 'another' would suggest more than two.

gaps.sentence: Every one of the switches ___ been tested twice.
gaps.explanation: 'Every one of' takes a singular verb: has.

gaps.sentence: ___ the food was eaten within minutes.
gaps.explanation: 'All the food' is correct with an uncountable noun; 'whole' needs 'the whole of' and 'both' needs two separate items.

gaps.sentence: ___ students joined the trip this year than last.

gaps.explanation: 'Neither of my parents is ...' is correct for two items with a singular verb; 'both/all' need a plural verb and 'none' is not used for two.
